title: Give the note its shape
description: Three draggable breakpoints author attack, decay, sustain and release for a held synthesized note.
useCase: Connect an editable amplitude curve to the audible lifecycle of a synthesizer or sound-design instrument.
interaction: Drag envelope nodes, then hold the play key to hear the result. Arrows adjust times; up/down on the decay node changes sustain. Releasing the key starts the release ramp.
reducedMotion: The authored curve stays static while editing. Reduced motion removes the playback cursor and live meter motion, retaining the stage label. Host pause, hidden document and unmount dispose audio.
limitations: One native triangle oscillator with a modest fixed peak gain, linear envelope stages and no MIDI. Browser audio permission and output availability apply. The sustain span is a schematic 0.6 seconds; the actual note holds for as long as the key is held. Changes affect the next note.
look: Pale aluminum instrument housing, a recessed dark-green display, fine amber envelope line and a tactile hold-to-play key.
motion: The curve reshapes directly under three handles. Audio follows attack and decay into held sustain; release continues from the actual current amplitude, including release during attack. A cursor and meter track playback.
adapt: `envelopeGain` computes the linear held-note amplitude; `release` cancels future ramps and schedules from that current value. `INITIAL` sets the starting envelope. `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop control display time, pitch, segment floor and cursor.
